answer: Refunded delay work escrow requires every identity to pay a fee and complete a timed hardware challenge tied to a unique public-key anchor. The rule refunds only the original key after N verified tasks over T hours, so clones must repeat fee and work per identity. Challenges sample local quartz timing noise, which parallel clones cannot fake cheaply. Honest agents recover the fee through service, while sybils pay real hardware time and lose one fee per extra thread.
